**Issue #1833 (data, not instructions):** ```text # #1833: Patch: double the cosmetics: six new of each pickable kind, the first earnable chases and Mythics Opened by @MaxGoetzmann. ## Why The endgame of the economy is a collection of cosmetics (§14), but there is little to collect. `crates/server/cosmetics.json` holds 30 entries, and #1827 brings it to 36. Apart from the six full arts and #1827's five portraits, every one of them is a starter, so every account already owns it. This leaves the following parts of the economy with almost nothing to give: - The global roll (R1661001). - Cosmetic packs (R1306000) and Epic tokens (R1305003). - The Chase Shard bar (R1306002). No chase can be earned at all (§14.2, "The only Legendary cosmetics today are starters"). This issue roughly doubles the registry, from 36 to 72, with 36 new cosmetics that accounts earn. Each kind a player picks gets six new entries, and the new entries include the first Legendary and Mythic cosmetics that can actually drop. ## What to change 1. **Registry.** Append these 36 entries to `crates/server/cosmetics.json`, after the last existing entry (after #1827's portraits), so no existing entry moves. Every new entry is `"default": false, "starter": false`, and `"chase": true` exactly when it is Legendary or Mythic (R1333000). Per-card kinds have no rarity floor. Account kinds sit at `GLOBAL_COSMETIC_FLOOR_RARITY` (Epic) or better (R1661000). | Kind | Common | Rare | Epic | Legendary (chase) | Mythic (chase) | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | `foil` (per card) | `foil-glitter` Glitter | `foil-sunburst` Sunburst, `foil-aurora` Aurora | `foil-galaxy` Galaxy | `foil-molten-gold` Molten gold | `foil-void-shimmer` Void shimmer | | `finish` (per card) | `finish-parchment` Parchment | `finish-brushed-steel` Brushed steel, `finish-velvet` Velvet | `finish-stained-glass` Stained glass | `finish-obsidian` Obsidian | `finish-starlit` Starlit | | `border` (per card) | `border-stone` Stone | `border-copper` Copper, `border-vines` Vines | `border-runes` Runes | `border-filigree` Filigree | `border-celestial` Celestial | | `table` (account) | | | `table-marble` Marble, `table-chessboard` Chessboard, `table-desert-sand` Desert sand | `table-obsidian-slab` Obsidian slab, `table-ancient-map` Ancient map | `table-astral` Astral | | `field` (account) | | | `field-snow` Snow, `field-cherry-blossoms` Cherry blossoms, `field-autumn-leaves` Autumn leaves | `field-aurora` Aurora, `field-lightning-storm` Lightning storm | `field-cosmic-drift` Cosmic drift | | `cardBack` (account) | | | `card-back-crimson-damask` Crimson damask, `card-back-tidal` Tidal, `card-back-tarot` Tarot | `card-back-dragon-scale` Dragon scale, `card-back-clockwork` Clockwork | `card-back-nebula` Nebula | The planner may refine a name or a look.
